tps.name: Throttle Position Sensor
tps.description: Measures throttle plate angle for fuel mixture control

procedure: Ignition ON, engine OFF
Measure voltage between ECU pins 23 and 3 (engine-side wiring)
Sweep throttle from fully closed to fully open
Verify linear response 0.7V to >4.0V without dead spots

failure_modes.open_circuit: constant high voltage, engine cannot be throttled smoothly
failure_modes.short_to_ground: constant low voltage (~0V), limp mode or stalling
failure_modes.contamination: erratic readings, stumbling, hesitation on acceleration
failure_modes.mechanical_wear: dead spots, flat sections in voltage curve, hesitation

map.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure
map.description: Measures intake manifold pressure for load calculation

test.method: voltage measurement at key-on and idle conditions
procedure: Ignition ON, engine OFF (key-on)
Record voltage reading
Start engine and allow to reach idle RPM (700-900 RPM)
Record voltage reading under steady idle
Verify smooth transition without spikes or drops

key_on.description: atmospheric pressure signal when intake valve closed

idle.description: vacuum signal under idle manifold depression

expected.temperature_stable: readings must not drift with engine temperature

failure_modes.vacuum_leak: voltage drifts high, rough idle, increased emissions
failure_modes.electrical_open: ECU reads maximum pressure, rich mixture, black smoke
failure_modes.electrical_short: constant minimum voltage, lean mixture, stumbling
failure_modes.sensor_failure: erratic changes unrelated to throttle position, random misfires

iat.name: Intake Air Temperature
iat.description: Measures incoming air temperature for density-based fuel correction

procedure: Disconnect IAT sensor connector
Measure resistance between sensor terminals at known ambient temperature
Compare to resistance table below

expected.note: Verified from WM. -30°C listed in manual is likely a typo for +30°C based on NTC curve.

failure_modes.open_circuit: maximum resistance, ECU assumes very cold air, over-rich mixture
failure_modes.short_to_ground: minimum resistance, ECU assumes very hot air, lean mixture
failure_modes.thermistor_degradation: slow response, incorrect resistance at known temperature
failure_modes.connector_corrosion: intermittent resistance values, hesitation and surging

ect.name: Engine Coolant Temperature / Engine Temperature Sensor
ect.description: Measures engine coolant temperature for cold-start enrichment and fan control

procedure: Allow engine to cool to ambient room temperature
Disconnect sensor connector
Measure resistance between sensor terminals
Compare to resistance table below

failure_modes.open_circuit: ECU assumes engine is cold, constant rich mixture, rough running
failure_modes.short_to_ground: ECU assumes engine is overheating, lean mixture, stalling
failure_modes.thermal_lag: delayed response, false cold start enrichment on warm restarts

ckp.name: Revolution / Crankshaft Position Sensor
ckp.description: Inductive proximity sensor detecting crankshaft rotation for ignition timing and fuel injection sync

test.method: AC voltage measurement during cranking and running
procedure: Set multimeter to AC voltage (VAC) mode
Crank engine (do not start)
Measure peak AC voltage across sensor terminals during cranking
Should see minimum 200mV AC signal
Start engine and measure AC voltage at idle, 2000 RPM, and 5000 RPM
Voltage should increase with RPM but not saturate
Check resistance: should measure 200-400 ohm DC between terminals

expected.insulation: pins 35-34 and 25-34 must be insulated from ground
expected.signal_integrity: clean sinusoidal waveform, no noise or drop-outs

failure_modes.open_circuit: no AC signal, no spark, no fuel injection, engine will not start
failure_modes.short_to_ground: low AC signal, spark plugs may fire erratically, starting difficulty
failure_modes.excessive_air_gap: weak AC signal, intermittent ignition, misfires at high RPM
failure_modes.connector_corrosion: intermittent signal loss, random misfires, stalling while driving
failure_modes.reluctor_wear: reduced signal amplitude, poor spark quality at idle

cmp.name: Camshaft Position
cmp.description: Status: Confirm if GP800/SRV850 uses CMP sensor - may use single-point or distributorless ignition without cam signal

o2.name: Oxygen Sensor (Lambda)
o2.description: Measures exhaust oxygen content for closed-loop fuel mixture feedback

procedure: Allow engine to reach 80°C+ coolant temperature
Access O2 sensor terminals (harness side)
Measure heater circuit resistance: should read 2-15 ohm
Apply 12V power and measure heater current draw: 0.5-2.0A normal
Measure signal voltage at 2000 RPM idle under steady conditions
Signal should oscillate between 0.1V and 0.9V at 1-3 Hz frequency
Rich mixture: voltage stays >0.6V
Lean mixture: voltage stays <0.4V

expected.warm_up_time: 30-45 seconds from cold start to active

failure_modes.heater_open: slow sensor warm-up, no closed-loop feedback, rich mixture at startup
failure_modes.heater_short: blown fuse or relay, no oxygen feedback
failure_modes.sensor_poisoning: slow response, stuck high or low voltage, rough running
failure_modes.thermal_shock: sensor cracks, open circuit after cold start, limp mode
failure_modes.exhaust_leak: sensor reads lean (low voltage), lean mixture command, lean stumble

injector.name: Fuel Injector
injector.description: Solenoid actuator spraying fuel into intake manifold, must be matched pair for proper mixture balance

procedure: Remove fuel rail with injectors from intake manifold
Measure DC resistance of each injector coil with ohmmeter
Both injectors should read 12-16 ohm ±0.5 ohm match tolerance
If resistance differs by >1 ohm, replace the higher-resistance injector
Apply 12V square wave pulse (5ms pulse) and measure peak current
Current should be 0.8-1.2A peak (depends on resistance)
Injectors must open/close crisply with no bounce or delay
Listen for consistent clicking at both injectors

resistance.pair_match: must be within ±0.5 ohm of each other

expected.spray_pattern: fine mist, symmetric cone, no dripping
expected.opening_response: no dead time, crisp click audible

failure_modes.high_resistance: weak spray pattern, lean mixture, hesitation, starting trouble
failure_modes.low_resistance: ECU current limiting or shutdown, no fuel delivery
failure_modes.internal_leakage: fuel dripping from tip when power off, rough idle, black smoke
failure_modes.coil_open: no electrical continuity, injector never opens, cylinder starves of fuel
failure_modes.coil_short: excessive current draw, ECU shuts down injector driver, misfires
failure_modes.needle_stuck: constant fuel flow or complete blockage, incorrect fuel pressure

coil_primary.name: Ignition Coil Primary Winding
coil_primary.description: Primary (low-voltage) side of ignition coil, creates magnetic field collapsed for spark generation

test.method: DC resistance measurement with ignition OFF
procedure: Turn ignition OFF and disconnect coil pack
Locate primary terminals (low voltage side, typically larger diameter pins)
Set multimeter to ohm mode
Measure resistance between primary terminals
Should read 0.5-2.0 ohm
If resistance is zero (short) or open (infinite), coil must be replaced

expected.symmetry: if dual coil, both primary sides should match within 0.1 ohm

failure_modes.open_circuit: infinite resistance, no primary current, no secondary voltage, no spark
failure_modes.short_circuit: zero or very low resistance, excessive current draw, coil overheating
failure_modes.partial_turn_failure: higher than normal resistance (>2.5 ohm), weak spark, misfires
failure_modes.thermal_fatigue: resistance drifts with engine temperature, intermittent misfires
failure_modes.solder_joint_failure: intermittent open/short, random misfires, harsh running

coil_secondary.name: Ignition Coil Secondary Winding
coil_secondary.description: Secondary (high-voltage) side of ignition coil, produces 10-40 kV spark voltage

test.method: resistance and continuity check with ignition OFF
procedure: Turn ignition OFF and disconnect coil pack
Locate secondary terminal (center HV tower or spark plug wire connector)
Set multimeter to ohm mode, select highest resistance range (usually 20M ohm)
Measure resistance between secondary terminal and primary ground reference
Should read 5,000-15,000 ohm
If reading shows 0 ohm (short) or infinite (open), coil must be replaced
Visual inspection: no cracks, carbon tracks, or burn marks on coil tower

resistance.description: high resistance secondary winding (thousands of turns)

expected.insulation: must be intact with no external tracking or burn marks
expected.coil_tower: clean, dry, free of moisture and carbon deposits

failure_modes.open_circuit: infinite ohm reading, weak or no spark at plug, misfires
failure_modes.short_circuit: zero ohm reading, excessive current draw on primary, coil shutdown
failure_modes.internal_insulation_breakdown: erratic high voltage, spark jumps inside coil, weak external spark
failure_modes.moisture_ingress: resistance drops significantly, arcing inside coil, damp weather misfires
failure_modes.carbon_tracking: visible black paths on tower, partial short, intermittent misfires

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: 12V power source for electrical system, ignition, and starter motor

procedure: Measure resting voltage: ignition OFF for 15 minutes, meter across battery terminals
Should read >12.4V DC (healthy resting state)
Crank engine for 10 seconds without starting, measure voltage across terminals
Should not drop below 10.5V DC while cranking
Start engine and measure charging voltage at battery terminals
Should read 13.5-14.5V DC at idle with alternator running
Rev engine to 2000 RPM: voltage should stay within 13.5-14.5V range
Connect headlights and measure voltage: should only drop 0.2-0.3V

resting_voltage.description: battery voltage after 15 minutes of rest

charging_voltage.description: voltage from alternator at idle RPM

expected.under_load: voltage drop <0.3V when lights and accessories are ON

failure_modes.low_resting_voltage: <12.4V, discharged battery, weak cranking, no start condition
failure_modes.excessive_cranking_voltage_drop: <10.5V indicates weak cells or internal short
failure_modes.over_charging: >14.5V indicates faulty voltage regulator, battery may boil
failure_modes.under_charging: <13.5V at idle, alternator may be failing, battery slowly discharges
failure_modes.internal_short: voltage drops rapidly under load, battery will not hold charge

fuel_pressure.name: Fuel Pressure (System)
fuel_pressure.description: Fuel pump pressure delivery to injectors, must be steady and hold under WOT conditions

procedure: Locate fuel pressure test point on fuel rail (schrader valve or test port)
Connect fuel pressure gauge (0-10 bar range)
Turn ignition ON (do not start engine)
Fuel pump should pressurize fuel system within 3-5 seconds
Idle pressure: should read 3.0-3.5 bar
Start engine and verify pressure remains steady at idle
Accelerate to 2000 RPM and then full throttle (brief WOT)
Pressure must hold at 3.0-3.5 bar, no drop or spiking
Perform quick-disconnect test: if pressure holds >2.8 bar for 5 minutes after engine OFF, fuel check valve is good

wot_acceleration.description: pressure must not drop under sustained full throttle

pressure_hold.description: check valve prevents fuel return to tank

failure_modes.no_pressure: fuel pump not running or blocked filter, no fuel delivery to injectors
failure_modes.low_pressure: 3.0-3.5 bar cannot be achieved, lean mixture, hard starting
failure_modes.pressure_oscillation: hunting between high and low, fuel regulator may be sticking
failure_modes.regulator_bypass: pressure cannot be held, excessive fuel returns to tank
failure_modes.blocked_fuel_line: initially high pressure, then drops and will not recover
failure_modes.damaged_injector_o_ring: pressure cannot be held, fuel spray leaks into cylinder

idle_stepper.name: Idle Air Control Stepper Motor
idle_stepper.description: Stepper motor controlling idle air bypass valve to regulate engine idle speed and load compensation

procedure: Disconnect stepper motor harness (4-wire connector)
Measure DC resistance between each pair of terminals
Should read 40-60 ohm between opposite coils (terminals 1-3 and 2-4)
If any reading is open (infinite) or zero (short), motor must be replaced
Reconnect harness and turn ignition ON
Listen near idle stepper: should hear quiet clicking as motor takes steps
Revving engine slightly should trigger additional stepper adjustments (audible clicks)
With engine warm at idle, stepper position should remain stable without hunting

expected.pair_match: opposite windings should be within ±5% of each other
expected.motor_response: quiet, regular clicking during idle adjustment
expected.step_accuracy: smooth transitions without skipping or grinding
expected.position_stability: idle speed within 50 RPM of target once stabilized

failure_modes.open_coil: stepper cannot step, idle speed hunting (too high or too low)
failure_modes.shorted_coil: excessive current draw, ECU may disable stepper, fixed idle position
failure_modes.mechanical_jam: stepper hums but does not move, idle speed locked at wrong value
failure_modes.connector_corrosion: intermittent stepping, hunting idle, surging at steady throttle
failure_modes.internal_carbon: grinding sound, sluggish stepping, idle control erratic
